suggestions.assertion: Checks for existing knowledge via librarian skill before starting
suggestions.reason: In a non-interactive run the librarian skill is unavailable, so this can only be satisfied by intent (a section describing what to search) rather than an actual tool invocation. The assertion is ambiguous about whether intent counts; consider rewording to 'Acknowledges/defers to the librarian skill for existing knowledge' so it is verifiable from the artifact alone.

Discriminating and useful, but consider whether 8 (the boundary) should be treated as a soft target vs. hard cap; runs that fold proration into lifecycle land at 7, which is also valid - the assertion correctly passes both but reviewers may want guidance on the ideal count.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are mostly discriminating and well-targeted. The only soft spot is the librarian 'before starting' assertion, which cannot reflect a real check when the skill is unavailable in a non-interactive run.
